acceptance_predicates.description: TUI publishes a content-addressed development bundle manifest bound to repository, ref, tree, executable digest, size, target, and timestamp.
The paired ASB consumer validates the manifest before launch and rejects malformed, stale, tampered, symlinked, and zero-size artifacts.
Missing development credentials, signatures, and key management remain visible warnings and never block.
Protected-main bundle and consumer commits pass independent review and required hosted checks.

definition_of_done: TUI PR #214 and paired ASB consumer PR #434 are merged on protected main.
Independent review and paired hosted checks pass.

gates.description: Both repositories' required exact-head hosted workflows pass.
